notes: Reviewed cumulative CES climate-action and fuel-efficiency extension. Preserve existing CES estimates. Full sample pre-election/single-wave weights; invalid weights and missing responses excluded. Fuel-efficiency variants share one family and do not overlap in year.

entries.title: Climate change: belief and willingness to act
entries.question: From what you know about global climate change or global warming, which statement comes closest to your opinion: immediate action is necessary; some action should be taken; more research is necessary before taking action; concern is exaggerated and no action is necessary; or climate change is not occurring?
entries.rationale: Five ordered responses mapped to equally spaced scores from +1 (immediate action) to -1 (climate change not occurring). This mixes belief and willingness to act, not support for one specific policy. More research is the scale midpoint, not an observed ideological neutrality. Guide tables 15–16, pages 17–18.
